analyses.content: 录音提到在小组环境（group situation对应题目中的group participation）中自由表达能赋予孩子们信心（confidence），即对应题目中的发展信心。
你可能听到“opinions and ideas”觉得耳熟，但这已经是题目里有的信息了，注意听“give them”后面紧跟的才是我们要填的真正核心词。
Firstly, creating the space for children to express themselves freely in a group situation helps to give them confidence in their own opinions and ideas.
录音原词重现了unscripted和imagination（对应题目中的imaginative），随后提到给孩子机会去承担风险（taking risks），这里的take直接对应答案risks。
你可能会想填experience或opportunity，但忽略了题目空前已经有“take”这个动词，只有risks能和它完美搭配成“take risks（冒险）”的意思。

Secondly, unscripted improvisation activities where children work from their imagination, if done in a supportive way, give children the opportunity to gain experience in taking risks and encourage them to say things that they might normally be afraid to say.
录音里的“learn the value of（学习……的价值）”直接同义替换了题目中的“teaches the importance of（教导……的重要性）”，后面紧跟的listening就是答案。
你可能被前半句的“cooperative activities”转移了注意力，做填空题时一定要耐心往后听完整句话，抓住表示“重要性/价值”的替换词。
For example, the emphasis placed on cooperative activities in drama means that group members must learn the value of listening to one another.
录音中明确说明表演能帮助孩子们对自己的学习和行为负责（be responsible for），完美契合题目中的“makes children... for their learning and behavior”。
这是一个较长的句子，你可能会在中途走神，或者只听到了动词/名词，而忽略了这里的空需要填入形容词responsible来表示“负责任的”。

Being involved in any sort of performance which relies on everyone working together and playing their part also helps children to be responsible, not only for their learning, but for their general behavior.
录音里的“having difficulties”替换了题目中的“experiencing problems”，而“a means of”替换了“a form of”，后面紧跟的therapy（治疗）就是答案。
你可能会想填means，但“a form of”和“a means of”意思是一模一样的，填入means语义就重复了，真正作为形式内容的是therapy。
The value of role-play for children who are having difficulties as a means of therapy is now widely accepted.
录音重现了explore controversial...subjects（对应题目中的issues），随后提到的“in a safe setting”直接替换了题目中的“in a ... environment”，答案即为safe。
你可能会想填setting，但题()目里已经有了environment（环境），填入setting会导致意思重复，你需要填的是修饰环境的形容词safe。
More generally, role-play also allows the teacher to explore potentially controversial or taboo subjects in a safe setting in which children feel at ease.
题目中的“understanding of”被录音中的“awareness of”替换，跟在它后面的morality（道德）就是我们要找的词。
听到前面的self-knowledge后你可能会放松警惕，一定要注意后面由and连接的并列信息，同时不要错把awareness当成答案填进去，它只是understanding的替换。
Getting children to examine their thoughts and opinions carefully can lead to a deeper self-knowledge and a stronger awareness of morality.
录音用“improve the level of”替换了题目里的“increase”，接下来明确提到了孩子们的参与度（children's participation），对应得出答案。
你可能听到了level就顺手写上了，但忽略了整体语义，真正被提高的核心事物是“参与度（participation）”，只填level在句意上是不完整的。
Bringing characters from the past to life in the classroom by doing classroom drama activities is an easy way to improve the level of the children's participation in the lesson.
录音中的“helps them to”等同于题目里的“makes it easier for children to”，后面紧跟的动作remember就是要填的正确答案。
录音里干扰信息很多（比如reenact），而且“历史事件（historical events）”被拉长替换成了“what happened and why it was important”，容易导致你跟不上录音从而错过前面的动词。

So drama in the history classroom makes for a livelier atmosphere, but getting children to reenact scenes from history can also be extremely useful as it helps them to remember what happened and why it was important, as well as helping to bring the past alive.
录音里的“find solutions to”直接替换了题目中的“find answer to”，紧跟着的historical problems告诉我们答案就是problems。
你可能一听到solutions就直接当答案填上了，但“find solutions to”和题干的“find answer to”是同一个意思，填入solutions就变成了“寻找解决办法的答案”，语义重复了。
Another way of doing this is to ask children to find solutions to historical problems using role-play. This can help to focus attention on why certain decisions were taken.
